title: I've never thought of The Mall in my dreams as imaginary because I've been there IRL.
content: I latched on to /r/TheMallWorld because of my Toilet World recurring dream, plus the airport and the hotel. I didn't think I had mall dreams until I saw AI generated pictures and I read descriptions of a large upscale mall, a giant aquarium, etc. etc. That's when I realised I *had* had mall dreams, but I didn't think anything of them because The Mall in the dream was one I've spent time in in real life. The mall is the Dubai Mall in the United Arab Emirates. If you do a Google image search for it, from what I can tell it's a match for what everyone is describing. Note that there are also 'Vegas' style artificial areas in the vicinity of the mall and in the rest of Dubai - they are artificial constructs designed to imitate real places. They're well done, but slightly surreal. For example, there are canals and boardwalks at the Souk Madinat Jumeirah. Bonuses - there is a giant airport bigger than most people would have ever seen, and tons of weird hotels. Peek behind the curtains and the place is a rabbit's warren of liminal spaces. So my question is: Are people describing a real place they have only viewed remotely, or did the designers of the real mall work from a dream scenario? Alternatives: I'm totally wrong about the concept; it's a complete coincidence; my dream is mine alone; or all of this is total nonsense.
